556:t_5:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「That wound...! You already had it before you fought me!」

556:t_5:47.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「$c's ground forces used to be my men. Fight them, and this is what happens.」

556:t_5:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even pushing through a wound like that, why on earth did you fight me...!?」

556:t_5:49.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I wanted to show you... who you really are...」

556:t_5:51.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You couldn't deliver the finishing blow... That's the answer.」

556:t_5:54.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I wanted to send you... home... I wanted to go home too... to my wife $$イリーナ$$... and my child...」

556:t_5:56.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I never told you either... did I... My wife... died of a medical accident... while carrying my child...」

556:t_5:57.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is that why you went along with $$レナード$$'s plan!? A man like you, for that spineless pipe dream!」

556:t_5:58.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Did you think I was... an invincible man?」

556:t_5:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「Isn't that what a father is supposed to be...!?」

556:t_5:60.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Any father... is like this once you peel back a layer... By the time you notice... you've only just become half a man...」

556:t_5:67.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

556:t_5:68.en:
$$カレン$$
「Where do you think you're going, $n!?」

556:t_5:69.en:
$n
「To pick up $$宗介$$! I'm leaving $$千鳥$$ to you!」

556:t_5:70.en:
$$甲児$$
「You can't, not from this point!」

556:t_5:71.en:
$$アルト$$
「He chose that himself... Let's wait.」

556:t_6:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I am so sorry... If everyone's feelings, carried through the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, could be synchronized with $$レーバテイン$$'s $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$...」

556:t_6:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought we could generate a field that blocks even spacetime tremors...」

556:t_6:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「Not when the all-important cockpit of $$レーバテイン$$ got destroyed, and $$宗介$$'s will can't be turned into power...」

556:t_6:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's nobody's fault... Everyone did everything they could...」

556:t_6:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's leave her be for now...」

556:t_6:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$宗介$$... From the scene outside that $$ソフィア$$ showed me, I thought you were dead...)

556:t_6:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
(But I cried as hard as I could, pulled myself together, and when I went outside, you were alive...)

556:t_6:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I was so happy, so happy... I even forgot all the hardship and sadness up to then, and yet you... in the end... were gone...)

556:t_6:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That's not fair... If this is how it ends... I wish I'd never made that promise...)

556:t_6:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Right up to the very end... you betrayed my expectations...)

556:t_6:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You war-crazy, gloomy, quiet-type jerk! Someone like you... someone like you!!」

556:t_6:18.en:
???
「How rude. Never mind war-crazy and gloomy, I should have stopped being the quiet type long ago.」

556:t_6:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, I promised you before the $$ラース・バビロン$$ assault. That I would return alive, without fail.」

556:t_6:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. I'm alive and well.」

556:t_6:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-you, how did you...!? You shouldn't be able to use the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$...」

556:t_6:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even when I couldn't, $$アル$$ did it for me.」

556:t_6:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レーバテイン$$'s cockpit was destroyed, but the core unit was intact.」

556:t_6:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「Even I was surprised, though. $$アル$$ used the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ all on its own and generated a force field...」

556:t_6:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「And the feelings of everyone in $c joined it, blocking that spacetime tremor. Who would have thought.」

556:t_6:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's my partner for you. $$アル$$ has guts that are wasted on a mere AI.」

556:t_6:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I'm sorry, $$千鳥$$. I told you back there that I would take you back to the classroom, but my fight is not over.」

556:t_6:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems I can't go back to $$陣代高校$$ for a while yet. So, even if it's only you, go on ahead...」

556:t_6:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then I'll be with you too, as a special member of $c.」

556:t_6:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Or am I worthless now that I'm no longer a $$ウィスパード$$?」

556:t_6:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Now that $$ソフィア$$ is gone, my power is gradually fading away...」

556:t_6:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Once it's gone, I'll be just an ordinary high school girl... I don't have a genius for command like $$テッサ$$, so I'll really become just a civilian.」

556:t_6:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Would someone like that be a nuisance in $c?」

556:t_6:40.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. I can vouch for your cooking. That talent will be put to good use on the Living Team.」

556:t_6:45.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You mean the one about taking me to the sea someday?」

556:t_6:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「That too, but I mean the one we made at $$ニケーロ$$.」

556:t_6:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... uh... When we meet again, a kiss...」

556:t_6:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「As you can see, we have met again.」

556:t_6:52.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But, look... $$カレン$$ and $$アルト$$ and the others are running over here...」

556:t_6:53.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's not that I mind, but here, you know...? I mean, everyone would see us, and even I...」

556:t_6:55.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I don't understand what's going on... But...)

イリーナ.evidence: Kalinin's late wife (妻のイリーナ, 5:54); Irina Kalinin in Full Metal Panic!; female (wife)
